name: Firefly Catch
description: A dusk meadow, a glass jar and slow glowing fireflies. Slide the jar to catch them for a calm 90 seconds. Missed ones just fly away.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Fireflies drift slowly down a dusk meadow. Slide a glass jar along the bottom to catch them.
help.goal: Catch as many fireflies as you like in a calm round of 90 seconds. There are no lives and no game over; missed fireflies just fly away.
howToPlay: Move the jar left and right under a drifting firefly.
A firefly that drifts into the jar mouth is caught.
After 90 seconds of play the round ends and shows how many you caught. Pausing stops the clock.
Press Play again for a new round. Your best is remembered.

controls.action: Start or resume after the Ready prompt
Reach the on-screen Left, Right and New round buttons

tips: Sit under a firefly early and let it drift into the jar.
Reduced motion makes fireflies slower and move in straight lines.
You can stop at any time. Your round is saved and waits for you.
